_why: The golden daily.note.md fixture pins the OUTLINE format on both sides, but
it structurally cannot pin the FRONT-MATTER: its TS half round-trips
tree.frontmatter verbatim and never calls the host's touchFrontmatter, so
outline.rs's hand-rolled line-based touch_frontmatter had no counterpart
assertion at all. These cases are asserted by BOTH sides —
backend/tests/golden.rs (Rust touch_frontmatter) and
src/lib/outline/roam-golden.test.ts (host touchFrontmatter, which goes
through the `yaml` package) — so the two implementations cannot drift.
`type` is OKF v0.2's one REQUIRED key (§4.1) and the host stamps it on
every document it writes. Every case carries it, as `Daily Note`: this
plugin only ever writes <daily_dir>/<yyyy>/<yyyy-MM-dd>.note.md, which is
what the host's outlineConceptType maps to CONCEPT_TYPE.dailyNote — not the
`Outline Note` default a caller that says nothing would get. Note the
asymmetry the host's own code produces and both sides must reproduce: a
missing key is APPENDED (type, then title, then created), so `type` lands
first only on a block that had no keys at all to append after.
The three non-mapping cases are the boundary (R6). The plugin does not
have to PRODUCE such a file to be handed one: it writes into whatever daily
note is already on disk, and a .note.md is hand-edited and agent-edited
(file-over-app). Both sides leave a block that is not a YAML mapping
exactly as it was, rather than appending key: value lines to a scalar and
leaving behind front-matter the host's own reader cannot parse as a map.

cases.name: a note with no front-matter at all gets all four keys, type first
a pre-OKF note gets type appended at the end, keeping every key it had in place
the golden fixture's own block: only updated moves, unknown key and order untouched
an existing type is never overwritten, even by a different one
a missing created is appended after type, so the order is stable
a block with no updated key gets one appended after type
an existing title is never overwritten, even by a different one
